result:
PR #403 is marked ready and goes to audit because it touches `hw/`. The device test of the line-mode cull change passed every registered check.

**Why the first attempt didn't finish:** it stopped, correctly, to wait for the device test, having posted a `waiting:` comment. Both device runs later completed, but the arms job never posted its `[job.arms]` verdict on the PR, so nothing brought the lane back until the handback job resumed it. I scored the two result folders against the committed prediction myself with `ab_compare.py --expect`. The result: **PASS, all 147 checks hold.**

| captures (4 of each) | structural px, before → after | predicted bound |
|---|---|---|
| FrontFace_LM_*_CF_FaB | 3,911 → 0 | ≤ 20 |
| the 3,030 rows | 3,030 → 688 | ≤ 720 |
| the 2,258 rows | 2,258 → 689 | ≤ 720 |

- **Counts:** 12 captures better, 0 worse, 401 unchanged out of 413. Exact matches went from 39 to 43, and none were lost.
- **Total:** structural pixels dropped by 31,288, close to the 31,152 the earlier analysis attributed to this defect.
- **Guards:** the Shade_model, Line_width and 3D_primitive suites are byte-identical between the two runs. The only 12 captures that differ at all are the 12 that improved.
- **Caveat:** there was one run per side, so the tool can't strictly separate the change from device noise. Every way the prediction said it could fail came out the other way, though.

**Done:**
- `docs/lanes/cull13/NOTES.md` records why the first attempt stopped and the verdict, with the table above.
- Commit `fa5f40de1e` is pushed.
- `preflight.sh --allow-tracker` passes.
- The PR body now carries the verdict, and its `Files:` line matches the diff against master.
- The same verdict is posted as a PR comment.

Master is 34 commits ahead of the branch, but `SHADER_STATE_LAYOUT_VERSION` is still 4 there, so this PR's bump to 5 needs no renumbering. GitHub reported the PR as mergeable when I checked this session. Folding it is the fold job's work.
